name: 焰火
evolution: 火花 → 焰火 Lv.16 → 火神 Lv.36 → 烈火战神
evolutionEn: Sparka → Yanhuo Lv.16 → Huoshen Lv.36 → Liehuozhanshen
description: 长出了一对大翅膀，但似乎并不是用来飞行的。能用双手释放出更加强力的火焰，但不太熟练。
descriptionEn: It has grown a pair of large wings, but they do not seem to be for flying. It can release more powerful flames with both hands, but is not very skilled at it yet.
